name: ELIXIR - Protein-Protein Interface Benchmark - OpenEBench Experiment
description: A benchmark that asks methods to classify a protein homodimer interface as physiological or crystallographic, scoring each entry so that higher means more likely physiological.

limitations: Leave-one-out evaluation in the random-forest consensus reference method does not remove homologous entries from the training set, so its AUROC should be read as an upper estimate with respect to the other methods.
Methods scored different numbers of entries (1,123 to 1,671), and methods scoring fewer than 1,671 entries are evaluated on their own subset, so values are not strictly comparable across rows.
16 labels differ from the original 2023 publication.
Reference scores are those submitted to the original benchmark repository.
